## Specific task description

Task instruction: Shake the lightweight plastic brown bottle after picking it with the right arm.

Task description: The target is the lightweight brown plastic bottle lying at an angle just right of center on the table, with a light-colored label. Use the right arm to pick it up and shake it.

Success criteria: The brown bottle has been picked up and shaken by the right arm, and at completion it remains suspended clearly off the table, higher than its initial horizontal position.

## Execution tips

- Grip the straight bottle section bearing the light label, closing across its long axis. Avoid the narrowed end near the silver bell and the rounded base at the other end to reduce sliding.
- Set the gripper opening slightly wider than the selected section of the bottle. Before closing, verify that the fingers are actually on opposite sides of the body and that the pads have enough contact area; avoid pressing down from above and rolling the bottle.
- Shake with small, smoothly reversing movements, leaving both ends of the bottle clear of the table, silver bell, and black post to reduce collisions and slipping from inertia.
- If the bottle body slides or rotates between the fingers, reduce the shake amplitude and adjust the grasp only after the bottle has reliable support, avoiding release while suspended.
